# Craft Upgrades

A lightweight addon that shows you what gear you can make with your professions that's better than what you're wearing. No extra windows, it just adds an Upgrades category to the top of your crafting window with those recipes, plus an Upgrades for [name] category for each of your other characters.

It looks and works like the rest of the crafting window: click a recipe to open it, right-click to favorite it, hover it to see the item. It updates as soon as you change gear, and it disappears when there's nothing better to make.

## Download
* <https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/craft-upgrades>
